system_context: Fictional GIEN / Sentinel v2.4 / Omni-Sentinel governance simulation

reporting_window.note: The 2026-11-06 09:00 UTC close had not occurred at the time of the 2026-11-06 10:03 UTC+06:30 audit.

disposition.reason: At least one unresolved P0 evidence reconciliation finding remains.

sources.note: Document explicitly states all indices, drills, filings, signatures and Merkle roots are simulated.
Same reporting window, earlier snapshot. It reports A-SRI 0.46 and GIEN-ZTAI-03 at 22% remediation.
Current implementation creates key material and committed batches in process memory; retention metadata models S3 Object Lock but no S3 API write is present in the inspected file.
Telemetry is generated with random values and the attestation sample sets PCR_MATCH true unconditionally; this is a simulation harness.
The PlusCal algorithm is inside a comment; the visible module defines no TLC variables/Init/Next/Spec for the claimed 72-invariant SIP proof.
The report date remains [Date] and the run transcript, TLC version, config, state count and output checksum are not supplied.
The review documents 21 passing OPA tests but scopes full policy review to governance_artifacts/rego; broader artifacts/policies modules are described as structural/catalogue references.

findings.title: Same-window systemic-risk representations are not on a reconciled metric scale
observations: The interim SGR-028 snapshot reports A-SRI 0.46 against a 0.45 threshold as ELEVATED.
The canonical daily dossier reports A-SRI 20.3 as GREEN.

The dossiers use materially different numerical scales across several indices (for example G-SRI 0.23 versus 26.7), without a published canonical normalization transform, units contract, metric version or lineage mapping.
required_closure: Publish a versioned metric dictionary defining units, scale, aggregation, missing-data handling, uncertainty and thresholds for all 12 indices.
Provide source observations and deterministic transformation code that reproduces both reports from the same event stream.
Have an independent reviewer sign a reconciliation record and supersede or explicitly qualify the conflicting snapshot.

findings.title: GIEN-ZTAI-03 appears in the interim snapshot but not in the final dossier sections inspected
observations: The interim snapshot identifies GIEN-ZTAI-03 as CVSS 6.4 MEDIUM, shared prompt-cache key derivation across tenant scopes, 22% remediated, with an ETA of 2026-11-07T15:00Z.
The canonical dossier reports GIEN-ZTAI-02 closed and does not carry a disposition for GIEN-ZTAI-03 in the inspected vulnerability section.
required_closure: Create or locate the finding record with affected component/version, exploitability, tenant scope, owner and evidence references.
Verify per-tenant cache isolation with negative cross-tenant tests and production configuration evidence.
Document the current remediation percentage and compensating control, or formally disprove and withdraw the interim finding with reviewer approval.

findings.title: PQC logger source does not implement a remote WORM write
observations: The logger creates ML-DSA-65 signatures and verifies an in-memory hash chain.
The chain is a Python list in process memory.
The Object Lock mode, bucket and retain-until values are generated as an in-memory metadata dictionary; the inspected implementation contains no S3 client or object upload.
required_closure: Implement a separately permissioned S3 Object Lock COMPLIANCE writer or equivalent approved immutable store.
Persist object version, retention mode, retention-until, legal-hold state, digest, signature and remote receipt.
Add independent read-after-write verification and tests that fail when the remote commit/receipt is absent.

findings.title: Legacy monitor cannot establish hardware-rooted attestation
observations: The sample HardwareAttestation.verify method returns true unconditionally.
Telemetry values are randomly generated and monitoring cadence is accelerated for a sandbox.
required_closure: Replace with a verifier for authenticated TPM quotes or TEE attestation reports.
Bind nonce, device identity, PCR/measurement policy, TCB version, verifier identity and freshness to the evidence record.
Run negative tests for replay, stale TCB, invalid signature, wrong PCRs and unsupported platform; preserve raw signed evidence.

findings.title: Published 72/72 SIP invariant claim is not reproducible from the root SIP source/report pair
observations: The root SIP source contains a PlusCal algorithm inside a comment and does not define the expected executable state variables and Spec.
The final TLC report has an unfilled date placeholder and lacks a reproducible TLC execution transcript and artifact checksums.
The repository does contain separate executable containment/admission models; those model checks must not be represented as the 72-invariant SIP federation proof.
required_closure: Create a canonical executable SIP module and finite model configuration covering the claimed invariants.
Pin the TLC tool version and record exact command, configuration, state counts, invariants/properties, output and source commit.
Add counterexample regression tests and have an independent reviewer reproduce the exact run.

findings.title: Transcript Registry and Intervention Proof Verifier lack independently identified deployed contract evidence
observations: The daily dossier describes registry entries and intervention proofs as simulated totals.
Scoped repository search did not identify source files defining contracts with the exact TranscriptRegistry and InterventionProofVerifier names.
A prior source-review report explicitly states that the tracked Solidity sources examined did not contain these named contract definitions.
required_closure: Identify canonical contract source, compiler settings, ABI, bytecode hash, chain/network, deployment transaction and independent audit.
Publish tests for authorization, replay resistance, duplicate sequence handling, verification-key rotation and fail-closed actuation.
Keep private transcript contents and proof witnesses off public chain; store commitments and revocation/supersession references.

findings.title: Passing OPA assurance subset does not establish every mapped policy module
observations: The policy review reports 21/21 tests for governance_artifacts/rego.
The same review says broader artifacts/policies modules are referenced but reviewed only for structure.
required_closure: Create a control-to-policy authority map with one canonical module per obligation.
Run unit, negative, mutation and cross-target consistency tests for every module designated release-blocking.
Record framework applicability decisions separately from the policy engine's technical test result.
